finding: Two different validation-gate sets are published
detail: data/methodology.json defines eight gates (G1 legal review, G2 provenance, G3 integrity screen, G4 out-of-sample, G5 sample size, G6 closing-line benchmark, G7 multiplicity correction, G8 correlation/parlay independence). The lab page prints ten gates (G01-G10) and docs/index.html advertises 10 gates per candidate. The sets are not the same, so a candidate cannot be scored against a stable specification. Needs one owner to reconcile; this session did not edit either file.

finding: Same correlation pair published twice on different samples
detail: data/correlation_findings.csv quotes r=0.2004 on n=92 for home_score_vs_away_score; data/official_2026_11_05/analysis.json quotes r=0.1994 on n=121. Both reproduce arithmetically; the difference is the date cut-off and neither page says which sample it uses. Recommend a single labelled sample per coefficient.

finding: A page labelled as live standings is a dated snapshot
detail: data/standings_live_2026-11-03.csv is labelled live but is the 3 November snapshot. Re-read today: Philadelphia 7-1 became 8-1, Detroit 6-1 became 6-2, Atlanta 4-4 became 5-4. Already published as needs review by an earlier session; this session re-confirms it against the official table rather than assuming it was fixed.

finding: No official market-price source exists, so edge, ROI, CLV and reward ranking cannot be verified
detail: No NBA page publishes sportsbook prices, and NBA Terms of Use Sec. 9 restricts use of NBA Statistics in connection with gambling. Every market-relative column therefore stays blank. Any figure that appears in a legacy archive is third-party (ESPN-carried) and is not treated as a first-party quote.

finding: README has an empty section heading
detail: README.md contains the heading '## Evidence state' immediately followed by '## Live site contents' with no content between them — a merge leftover. Not edited here because README.md is outside this session's file scope; logged as a request to the README owner.

finding: README names a different session's branch
detail: README.md says 'This session works on the fixed Arena branch arena/74d27b5d-own6', which belongs to an earlier session. The branch is a historical record, but README presents it as current. Request to the README owner.

finding: Ten separate Flagged for Review pages
detail: docs/assurance/flagged.html, docs/coverage/flagged.html, docs/daily/flagged.html, docs/flagged.html, docs/hub/flagged.html, docs/lab/flagged.html, docs/own6/flagged.html, docs/review/flagged.html, docs/verified/flagged.html and docs/verify/flagged.html all exist. A reader cannot tell which list is authoritative or whether an item was fixed. Recommend one consolidated page that links the section lists.

finding: Two competing entry points to the site
detail: The repository root index.html redirects to docs/assurance/, while docs/index.html is a separate landing page with a different information architecture. A visitor arriving at the project URL lands on the assurance dashboard and may never see the landing page. Logged for the integration owner; not changed here to avoid conflicting with open PR #50 which also touches docs/index.html.
The official games-per-date calendar was read for November 2026 only. For the 12 October dates in the archive no official count was read, so those dates are shown blank rather than assumed complete.

Three game cards were opened at spread-out dates (Oct 20, Nov 2, Nov 4) and matched. The 118 remaining games were checked only in aggregate through the standings reconciliation, which cannot detect a swapped pair of scores that preserves both records. Stated as a coverage limit, not as full verification.

finding: Legacy market and player data are third-party, not official
detail: data/forward_test_2026-11-02.csv, data/our_lines_2026-11-02.csv and the teammate player-prop correlation were built from ESPN-carried odds and gamelogs. They are useful history but they are not official NBA sources and were not re-read in this session, so no row of them is marked verified here.

finding: Games-behind column shows placeholders for three Western teams
detail: The official standings page prints '--' for games behind on Western ranks 1, 2 and 3 (Portland 6-1, Los Angeles Lakers 7-2, Houston 7-2). Transcribed verbatim; this section does not substitute a computed value or reorder the table.

finding: No licence file in the repository
detail: The GitHub API reports license: null for sassnarep3-star/Own6. The terms under which the research code and the transcribed tables may be reused are therefore unstated, which matters more than usual because the underlying statistics are the NBA's property.

finding: The six strategy candidates are prose, not a registry
detail: docs/index.html advertises six frozen candidates and the count is hard-coded in scripts/build_lab.py. No data file enumerates them (data/strategies.json has zero rows), so a checker cannot detect drift between the advertised candidate family and any future implementation, and the Bonferroni correction cannot be audited against a list.

finding: NBA rights for any gambling-related reuse remain unresolved
detail: NBA Terms of Use Sec. 1 restricts linking to and reuse of Basketball Content without written permission, and Sec. 9 states NBA Statistics may not be used in connection with gambling activity, including legal gambling activity. No permission or legal opinion is held. Every page in this project is a research record, not a betting product, and this session does not assert an authorization.
